denominator_policy: All original positive relevance judgments are retained, including unfaithful or rejected parents; no conditioning on ingest survival.
grading: Hit is any positive gold at the cutoff; document recall averages per-query gold coverage; nDCG uses (2^grade-1)/log2(rank+1) against original graded qrels; MRR is first positive rank reciprocal. Exact turns and session hits are separate.

limitations: Single serial query pass per independent hosted cell; no repeatability, general superiority or generated-answer accuracy claim.
Previously inspected direct-fact, long-text and six-query LongMemEval fixtures are bounded regressions, not independent held-out or full-population evaluations.
All submitted parents remain in original relevance denominators; unfaithful returned slots retain rank and receive no relevance credit.
Auxly's first ten distinct native matches form an unordered returned subset; ranked Hit/MRR/nDCG are unavailable.
SDK and MCP latencies are separate interface strata; ingestion contracts and dependency environments also differ.
Linux Python 3.12.16 native observations consume Windows Python 3.14/3.10 qualification snapshots; shared version equality is not identical platform or wheel-byte qualification.
Sampled tree RSS can double-count shared pages and miss peaks; sampled CPU can miss exited children.
Mesh uses overlapping window pooling; Mem0 truncates identical MiniLM assets at 256 tokens. Basic Memory and Auxly have no embeddings in these profiles.
